part.text:
Migration complete! Successfully migrated from Pages Router to App Router.

**Migrated files:**

| Pages Router | → | App Router |
|--------------|---|------------|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | → | `app/layout.tsx` (root layout with Inter font) |
| `pages/_error.js` | → | `app/error.tsx` + `app/global-error.tsx` |
| `pages/404.js` | → | `app/not-found.tsx` |
| `pages/index.js` | → | `app/page.tsx` (dynamic server component) |
| `pages/blog/index.js` | → | `app/blog/page.tsx` (ISR revalidate: 60s) |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` | → | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` (ISR + generateStaticParams) |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | → | `app/api/posts/route.ts` (GET/POST handlers) |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | → | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (GET/PUT/DELETE handlers) |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | → | `components/AppProvider.tsx` (with "use client") |

**Key changes:**
- Server Components by default (no `getServerSideProps`/`getStaticProps`)
- Route Handlers use `Response.json()` instead of `res.status().json()`
- Metadata API replaces `<Head>` components
- `headers()` from next/headers replaces `req.headers`
- `generateStaticParams()` replaces `getStaticPaths`
- Full TypeScript types added throughout
